decision.description: The reference documents a top-level decision block, which keeps the command from running like permissionDecision deny. approve is typed only by the Agent SDK's generic output; inspection of the Claude Code 2.1.332 CLI during the audit, not cited as a source, suggests it has no effect.

permissionDecision.description: allow adds nothing: the command runs unless a hook refuses it. deny, ask, and defer all keep it from running.

updatedInput.description: Never applied. Any value keeps the command from running.

hookEventName.description: PreToolUse selects the PreToolUse output format, which this event also accepts so one script can serve both events.

additionalContext.description: Accepted in a PreToolUse-format answer; whether it has any effect on this event is undocumented.

reason.description: The reason for a top-level decision block; Claude reads it in place of the command's output.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false; it stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it if the conversation continues.
